timeline.event: The Zhou dynasty overthrows the Shang

timeline.event: Confucius is born in the state of Lu
timeline.label: c. 551 BCE

timeline.event: Qin Shi Huang unifies China and becomes its first emperor
timeline.label: 221 BCE

timeline.event: Cai Lun presents his improved method of making paper
timeline.label: 105 CE

timeline.event: The Tang dynasty is founded
The Diamond Sutra, the oldest known dated printed book, is made
Zhao Kuangyin founds the Song dynasty
Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty
Zhu Yuanzhang founds the Ming dynasty
Zheng He sets sail on the first of his treasure voyages
Construction of Beijing's Forbidden City is completed
Qing forces enter Beijing as the Ming dynasty falls
The First Opium War begins
The Republic of China is proclaimed, ending imperial rule
The Communist Red Army sets out on the Long March
The People's Republic of China is proclaimed

Hong Kong is handed over from Britain to China

places.name: Forbidden City, Beijing
places.clue: For nearly 500 years this vast palace was home to 24 Ming and Qing emperors and closed to ordinary people.

places.name: The Bund, Shanghai
places.clue: This riverside promenade of colonial-era banks faces the futuristic skyline of Pudong across the Huangpu River.

places.name: Terracotta Army
places.clue: Thousands of life-size clay soldiers, each with a different face, were buried to guard the tomb of China's first emperor.

places.name: Potala Palace, Lhasa
places.clue: Rising from Red Hill at about 3,700 m, this vast palace of over a thousand rooms was the winter residence of the Dalai Lamas.

places.name: Hong Kong
places.clue: Its name means 'fragrant harbour', and its skyline holds more skyscrapers than almost any other city on Earth.

places.name: Guilin
places.clue: Boats from here glide down the Li River past karst peaks so famous they appear on the back of the 20-yuan note.

places.name: Zhangjiajie
places.clue: Its thousands of towering sandstone pillars inspired the floating mountains of Pandora in the film Avatar.

places.name: Mogao Caves, Dunhuang
places.clue: A sealed library cave in these Buddhist grottoes hid the Diamond Sutra, the world's oldest known dated printed book.

places.name: Harbin
places.clue: Every winter it hosts a huge ice and snow festival, with full-size buildings carved from blocks of river ice.

places.name: Kashgar
places.clue: This far-western oasis was a great Silk Road crossroads, where caravan routes skirting the Taklamakan Desert met.

places.name: Qufu
places.clue: Confucius's hometown holds his temple, his family's mansion and a forest cemetery used by his descendants for over 2,000 years.

places.name: Leshan Giant Buddha
places.clue: Carved into a riverside cliff over about 90 years of the Tang dynasty, this 71 m figure is the world's largest stone Buddha.
